title: Compact Primary Actual-WOFOST Biomass State and Actual-WRT View
purpose: Define and, if the source-bound gate remains clean, implement the smallest primary actual-WOFOST biomass continuation carrier that owns WRT without duplicating root-geometry state. Keep crop evolution, phenology, optional dead-biomass capabilities and potential shadow state out of this workunit.

representation.leaf_cohort_count: derived from equal allocatable cohort-array lengths rather than persisted as a second independent count
representation.leaf_arrays: store active cohorts only; do not allocate legacy fixed 366 entries per column
representation.actual_WRT_view: read-only scalar accessor from the primary biomass carrier
representation.SoA_pool_batch_future_layout: permitted; logical type does not prescribe final MultiSWAP storage layout

reconstructible_not_independent_state.WLV: ordered sum of active LV cohort biomass
reconstructible_not_independent_state.LASUM: ordered sum of LV*SLA across active cohorts
reconstructible_not_independent_state.LAI: LASUM + SSA*WST + SPA*WSO using immutable crop parameters
reconstructible_not_independent_state.ILV: active cohort-array length in the compact representation

excluded_from_core_state.fl_potential: trajectory/configuration identity, not dynamic biomass state
excluded_from_core_state.DWRT: legacy dead-root accumulator used for output/restart but not by core WOFOST biomass evolution
excluded_from_core_state.DWST_DWLV: optional physical continuation for grassland management and/or nutrient routes; add only when those capabilities are active
excluded_from_core_state.DVS_TSUM_vernalization: crop lifecycle/phenology state owned outside this biomass carrier

validation: LV/SLA/LVAGE arrays all allocated together or all zero-length
all LV/SLA/LVAGE values finite and nonnegative
empty cohort state is allowed only when no active leaf biomass is represented
no fixed 366-element persistent allocation is required
transaction_semantics: carrier extends transaction_state_t and deep-clones allocatable cohorts
F-KT committed initialization/checkpoint must preserve all core biomass and cohort history
trial mutation/discard must not mutate committed biomass
same-checkpoint replay must be bitwise deterministic

read_only_view.source: root_biomass_WRT in the primary committed biomass carrier

forbidden: fixed 366-element cohort arrays per inactive/short-lived column
crop evolution implementation in this workunit
runtime or solver ownership of crop biomass
blind import of historical F-WOF04-F-WOF10 production
